posts.zh:
dsh-model-search 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2dc726dbccb9596c8cb9.html
posts.en:
dsh-model-search is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2dc726dbccb9596c8cb9.html
